its New Flyer subsidiary was awarded a contract by the Central Ohio Transit Authority for up to 45 60-foot Xcelsior CNG heavy-duty transit buses.
The contract includes a firm order for 12 buses and options for up to 33 additional buses.
The firm order will be added to NFI’s Q3 2026 backlog, while the option buses will be added to its option backlog.
The buses will replace aging vehicles and support new bus rapid transit service in Columbus. The purchase is backed by the federal Low-No Grant Program.
New Flyer has delivered more than 230 buses to COTA since 2000, including 102 CNG buses.

title: NFI’s New Flyer wins order for 12 CNG buses
